area: Wave 6 review: backend fixes (scope, run lock, one IDN encoder, one pack reader, integration tidy-ups)
title: Backend items of the orchestrated Wave 6 review: change-queue fix recipes, deployment Undo, host-name encoding, pack-file reading, remediation and AI Guard wording

checks.what: A fix recipe is scope-checked when filed in the change queue and when applied from it, before sign-in, as on the direct route (every recipe policy, RULE-DESC per rule type)
A deployment Undo takes the per-tenant write-run lock once for its confidence-tweak PUTs and its removal; busy means nothing read or written, audited
Every module that places a host name (Path analyzer, ZPA analysis, ZPA builder, Bulk changes) gives one ASCII form (UTS 46) for the same typed name
Deploy, Terraform export, the library and the fan-out tool give one verdict for the same pack file (BOM, wrong field type, oversize, deep nesting)
Every AI Guard plan with a change, Undo included, refuses an execute with a blank phrase and writes nothing
NaN and Infinity HAR counts: exactly 422 json_invalid over HTTP, 0 in _batch_hosts
Fix recipes: no PATCH path (a merge recipe reads and PUTs the whole rule, fail closed); the plan and dry run say so

findings.title: The change queue's fix-recipe path (file, then apply) skipped the Scope check the direct remediation route enforces, so an approved fix could read and write a rule policy not in scope
findings.fix: One helper (_require_recipe_in_scope) on the direct route, on /api/change-queue/recipe and on apply of a fix_recipe, before sign-in; the request models take the optional Scope fields and both pages send them

findings.title: Deployment Undo PUT dictionary confidence outside the per-tenant write lock and before the busy check, then reported that nothing was read or written
findings.fix: pack_deploy.undo holds ops.tenant_run for the tweak PUTs (rate limits, run control, audited run) and the removal (remove_deployment tenant_held, _execute_locked); busy is refused and audited

findings.title: Two IDN encodings: the ZPA analysis, ZPA builder and Bulk changes mapped deviation characters (straße to strasse) while the Path analyzer and browsers keep them (xn--strae-oqa)
findings.fix: zpa_analysis, ops_zpa.check_domain and admin_ops._ascii_host use zia_path_modules.ascii_host / entry_host (UTS 46); the dead fallback in parse_destination is gone

findings.title: Two pack-file readers disagreed: a BOM pack deployed but failed the Terraform export and the library; a non-text name was refused by deploy but rendered by the export
findings.fix: pack_terraform, pack_library, dlp_importer and tools/fan_out_channels.py read through pack_deploy.load_pack_file

findings.title: remediation.execute kept a dead PATCH branch with a weaker read check, and the preview showed a description-only PUT body without saying the rule is read and sent back whole
findings.fix: PATCH branch removed (a PATCH recipe is refused, nothing sent); plan() and the dry run carry a merge note shown in the previews and the queue item

findings.title: Records and test names described superseded behaviour: an omitted remediation state 'refused' (it is planned DISABLED) and monitor-only AI Guard 'keeps the count rule' (it asks its phrase)
findings.fix: SBD-WRITES-09/10 and the test wording corrected; AI Guard tests execute with a blank phrase (plan and Undo plan) and see a refusal with no write

findings.title: The HAR NaN/Infinity test accepted 400 or 422, so it did not pin the strict JSON parser, and the _batch_hosts guard was untested on its own
findings.fix: The HTTP test asserts exactly 422 json_invalid; a direct _batch_hosts test shows NaN and infinite counts become 0
